item.title: Top 2 Methods to Solve: Python setup.py develop vs install
item.description:
When navigating the realms of Python package management, one might encounter the terms develop and install with respect to the setup.py script. These two commands serve different purposes that can significantly impact your workflow whether you’re a developer or a user.

What is the Purpose of setup.py develop?

When you run the command:

python setup.py develop

This doesn’t really install the package in the traditional sense. Instead, it creates a special link (an .egg-link file) in the site-packages directory. This file acts as a reference back to your source code directory, allowing you to make changes directly in your source code without needing to reinstall the package each time you make an update.
